plain_english: Make the hard handy and sweeten the bitter — his memory alone is valiant: him we mind, the lover's bane.
sanskrit_cite: duṣkaraṃ sukarīkartuṃ duḥkhaṃ sukhayituṃ tathā ekavīrā smṛtir yasya taṃ smarāmaḥ smaradviṣam

plain_english: Long live the hymns that sing the high lord — at whose bare name the great break out in bristling thrill.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti gītayo yāsāṃ sa geyaḥ parameśvaraḥ yannāmnāpi mahātmānaḥ kīryante pulakāṅkuraiḥ

plain_english: Were you as you are, O Becoming, in the beyond — your hosts of power marshalled to launch and close the triple world.
sanskrit_cite: bhavān iva bhavān eva bhaved yadi paraṃ bhava svaśaktivyūhasaṃvyūḍhatrailokyārambhasaṃhṛtiḥ

plain_english: Spell you are, spell-fit you are, spell-master — what second wizard besides you? Come, hand me that spell, lord, that I turn spellbound to you.
sanskrit_cite: mantro 'si mantraṇīyo 'si mantrī tvattaḥ kuto 'paraḥ sa mahyaṃ dehi taṃ mantraṃ tvanmantraḥ syāṃ yathā prabho

plain_english: Light-shaped, vow-true — the self in you is mine, am I: yet called a drifter — O lord, what dream is this, and how in you?
sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaḥ satyasaṃkalpas tvam ātmā yasya so 'py aham saṃsārīti kim īśaiṣa svapnaḥ so 'pi kutas tvayi

plain_english: Unsnapped, unchurlish, single, sound — in you, lord, stands the fortune of men who stake their harvest on you.
sanskrit_cite: tad abhaṅgi tad agrāmyaṃ tad ekam upapattimat tvayi karmaphalanyāsakṛtām aiśvaryam īśa yat

plain_english: Strong to crush what ills, to deal what boons — or not? Here he is, our darling, god of gods on the bull-flag.
sanskrit_cite: kṣamaḥ kāṃ nāpadaṃ hantuṃ kāṃ dātuṃ sampadaṃ na vā yo 'sau sa dayito 'smākaṃ devadevo vṛṣadhvajaḥ

plain_english: For god-sight filmed with inborn stain, lord, your love is the last salve that rinses clean.
sanskrit_cite: māyāmayamalāndhasya divyasya jñānacakṣuṣaḥ nirmalīkaraṇe nātha tvadbhaktiḥ paramāñjanam

plain_english: Fear-free, bliss-full, one, unwasting — plant that foothold in me, come, god — quick, why linger?
sanskrit_cite: nirbhayaṃ yad yad ānandamayam ekaṃ yad avyayam padaṃ dehy ehi me deva tūrṇaṃ tat kiṃ pratīkṣase

plain_english: Ah, bottomless and grim, the drowning sea of rounds; ah, to ferry it — some high one — great Master.
sanskrit_cite: aho nisargagambhīro ghoraḥ saṃsārasāgaraḥ aho tattaraṇopāyaḥ paraḥ ko 'pi maheśvaraḥ
